about_the_game:
Adventarum is a fantasy idle battler and looter where your journey begins as a humble adventurer. Battle through forests, lakes, mountains, and beyond, collecting powerful gear and rare treasures. Rise through the ranks of the Adventurer’s Guild, take on quests, and unlock new skills to shape your hero.

As the game grows, so will your role—craft weapons, forge alliances, and eventually manage the guild itself. Whether you play actively or let your party fight while you’re away, your story continues in a living world of quests, loot, and legends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD equivalent or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Adventarum is a fantasy idle battler where you fight monsters, earn loot, and rise through the Adventurer’s Guild. Upgrade skills, craft gear, and unlock epic quests as you grow from lone adventurer to guild master.
